pages.scan: Opened works/auto-6294ee8a2094/workflow/storyboards-unnumbered/page-08.png with Read. It loaded. The page has 4 panels: a top pair, a wide middle panel and a large bottom panel.
pages.observation: Natural order: 'Tomorrow, care may take us beyond our hometown.' (ravi), teal 'WELBUK VISION' then 'specialist' face then caption 'The vision: trusted connections between clinics, specialists, and patients across locations.', teal 'WELBUK VISION' again, 'One connected ecosystem for care and family wellness.' (ravi, partner, child), teal 'Welbuk Practice • Welbuk Care • Welbuk Health' (meera, ananya, ravi), then bottom caption 'Welbuk — Building a connected healthcare ecosystem.' Issues: (1) In the bottom panel the teal label overlaps Ravi's face box, and his label is clipped to 'rav'. The label covers a face, so it must move. (2) In the top-right panel the teal label overlaps the panel's top-left border, and the caption box sits on and doubles the panel's bottom border. (3) 'WELBUK VISION' is repeated in two consecutive panels. Teal means on-screen text, but no screen or viewer is shown, so it reads as a heading, not a label. (4) The jump to 'Tomorrow' is a speculative future with no clear narrator. Who is 'us' and 'our hometown' (Ravi? the clinic?) Ravi is shown alone. (5) The specialist, partner and child are new and unexplained. The family is presumably Ravi's, but the page does not say so. (6) The walkthrough Meera promises on page 07 never happens, and the story becomes a brand montage. (7) The large bottom panel is mostly empty apart from three small faces at the top and the tagline at the bottom left. The ending has no character beat or dialogue.
